verdicts.reason: Apart from the body copy's line breaks, the two layouts are identical. Both have the same flaws: big dead gaps between headline and body and between body and CTA leave the stack looking scattered; the orange rule has moved above the eyebrow label instead of sitting under the headline; the legal line is too small to read; and the tall header band holds a tiny logo. A breaks the body copy as 'When it / is gone…', which leaves a loose, uneven rag. B's 'When it is / gone…' breaks a little more evenly.
